ingestionGap.finding: src/connectors/kalshi/client.ts fetchMarkets walks /events?status=open in provider order and stops at RUNNER_SCOUT_MARKET_LIMIT (250). It applies no series or sport targeting, so tonight's KXNFLGAME/KXNFLSPREAD/KXNFLTOTAL events are never reached and the local store holds zero contracts for this game.
ingestionGap.evidence: Kalshi reported UP at 2026-09-29T00:06:16Z and returned only World Cup futures and NFL career-milestone series.
ingestionGap.proposedFix: Add an explicit series-ticker fetch path (KXNFLGAME, KXNFLSPREAD, KXNFLTOTAL) so scheduled events are ingested by canonical event rather than by pagination luck.
